capabilities: Extract highlights, strikethroughs, sticky notes and caret marks from annotated PDFs
Map each annotation to a source line via fuzzy matching with AsciiDoc syntax stripped
Navigate, re-link and resolve review items from a panel with line highlights and gutter badges
Apply editor-suggested deletions and replacements to the source as undoable edits
Manage review rounds and mappings, export Markdown reports, and stamp replies into freshly rendered PDFs
disambiguation: Not a PDF annotation or reading tool; it reads PDFs an editor has already marked up and maps those marks back onto AsciiDoc source lines.
extras: Also ships as a VS Code extension and an npm CLI (@eddie-doc/cli) sharing the same v3 review sidecar format. Obsidian plugin is BRAT-installable; semantic-matching fallback is desktop-only and off by default; all processing is local with no telemetry.
problem: Reconciling an editor's PDF annotations against the original .adoc by hand is slow and error-prone, and Asciidoctor rebuilds lose all marks, so review state has nowhere to live.

relations.evidence: Rescue unmatched items via a local embedding model served by Ollama
Extracts highlights, strikethroughs, underlines, sticky-note comments, and caret/insert marks from the PDF (via pdfjs)

summary: Maps an editor's annotated PDF back onto your AsciiDoc source as navigable, resolvable review items, with rounds, replies, reports and stamped PDFs.
